sources.title: Bangladesh travel advice
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bulgaria
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Bulgarian MFA travel-advice page, last updated 1 December 2025, directly labels regular Bulgarian passports visa-required and specifies a pre-issued visa.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Bulgarian citizens need a pre-issued visa and should contact a diplomatic mission of Bangladesh.

sources.title: Visa-on-Arrival in Bangladesh
sources.officialityEvidence: Bangladesh Police's live Special Branch service says tourists from European countries may obtain an arrival visa, conflicting with Bulgaria's pre-issued-visa instruction.
sources.supportingExcerpt: People from the following categories in European countries may obtain a Visa on Arrival ... Tourists.

sources.title: Botswana travel advice
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bulgaria
sources.officialityEvidence: The Bulgarian MFA's live travel-advice page, last updated 15 October 2025, names regular Bulgarian passports and the Botswana short-visit exemption.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Bulgarian nationals do not need visa for visits up to 90 days.

sources.title: Panama travel advice
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bulgaria
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Bulgarian MFA Panama travel-advice page, last updated 18 February 2026, directly specifies the Bulgarian citizen visa-free stay limit.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Българските граждани могат да пребивават в страната без визи за срок до 90 дни.

sources.title: Tunisia travel advice
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bulgaria
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Bulgarian MFA Tunisia travel-advice page, last updated 15 October 2025, labels ordinary passports visa-free and gives the short-visit limit.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Българските граждани не се нуждаят от виза за посещения в Република Тунис за период до 90 дни.

sources.title: Ukraine travel advice
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of Bulgaria
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Bulgarian MFA Ukraine travel-advice page, last updated 17 February 2026, labels ordinary passports visa-free and expressly limits the exemption to biometric passports.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Освобождават се от виза само притежателите на биометрични паспорти.

policies.title: Bulgarian ordinary passports: named visa-free short visits
policies.summary: Current Bulgarian MFA travel guidance directly records visa-free short visits for Bulgarian citizens to Botswana, Panama, Tunisia and Ukraine.
conditions: Botswana, Panama and Tunisia each allow a stay of up to 90 days according to the cited Bulgarian MFA guidance.
Ukraine's exemption is limited to biometric passports and permits short stays of up to 90 days within six months; non-biometric passport holders require a visa.
For every destination, work, residence, transit, special documents, border access, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.
